body:
Leading slash in uri followed by column fails.

## Expected Result

```python
requests.get('http://127.0.0.1:10000//v:h')
<Response [200]>
```

## Actual Result

```python
Traceback (most recent call last):

           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
```

## Reproduction Steps

```python
import requests
requests.get('http://127.0.0.1:10000//v:h')

```
